summary: lib/queue.sh: as it exits having started runs, runs `harness gc <dir> --all-merged --deps` once per distinct PROJECT_DIR of its runs, lines `gc <name>: …` in runner.log before the debrief line; a non-zero exit logs `gc <name> failed (exit <n>)` and the debrief still starts. Two checks; docs, README, decision file.
verified_how: tests: 314 → 316, red first (only the two new checks failed), then 316/316 via lib/check.sh (green in 541 s); runner.log in a KEEP=1 run showed the gc line, its removals and branch deletes before 'harness debrief (detached'; the gcfail runner logged 'gc proj failed (exit 1)' and the debrief count rose by one; bash -n lib/queue.sh tests/run.sh

dead_ends.tried: letting the suite's runners gc proj as is
dead_ends.why: they removed stoppy, demo, walled and other merged fixture worktrees that later debrief and desk checks read (5 FAILs): tests/run.sh now keeps them dirty with an untracked marker (keep_wts/unkeep_wts) around the three runners that start runs

discoveries.text: Every queue runner in tests/run.sh that starts a run now gcs $T/proj: a new runner test that starts runs must wrap itself in keep_wts … settle; unkeep_wts if later checks read existing worktrees. The queue's own runs' worktrees are gone afterwards; their records are read from $T/ledger/proj/<run>/.

A meta.env without PROJECT_DIR inherits the caller's PROJECT_DIR when sourced (sessions export one): queue.sh unsets it before sourcing. debrief.sh rec_dir and other `source meta.env` sites may have the same leak.
The 'queue holds an entry whose project has a live run' flake: busy3 now sleeps 5 and the runner's --until is +3 s (was 3 and +1), so a slow runner start-up no longer misses starting stoppy-o.
